sources.description_text:
Can one AI workflow actually save money after we count software cost, review time, and revisions?

In this CreatorOS experiment, I compare a repeatable five-output content workflow against a manual process. The walkthrough measures time, usable outputs, human review, and an illustrative capacity-value calculation.

The calculator in this video is an example—not Synapse-X AI’s financial statement and not a guarantee of savings. It uses these clearly stated assumptions: 150 minutes manually, 55 minutes with the workflow including review, 95 minutes recovered, and an illustrative $30 hourly value. Capacity value is not the same as cash savings; your result depends on your real baseline, usage volume, hourly value, quality, revisions, integration costs, and how you use the recovered time.

Official pricing references shown in the video can change. ChatGPT Plus is listed by OpenAI at $20/month; ChatGPT Business standard seats are listed at $20/month when billed annually or $25/month when billed monthly. API usage is separate. Check the official pages before making a purchase.
